data.one_liner: Native video and image compression for Android, iOS, and Web without FFmpeg.
data.what_it_does: Compresses videos and images natively using hardware-accelerated platform encoders on Android, iOS, and Web. Supports target size, bitrate, and quality controls without bundling an FFmpeg binary.
use_when: You need to compress videos or images before uploading them.
You want cross-platform media compression without adding FFmpeg or GPL dependencies.
You need to target precise output file sizes or bitrates.
avoid_when: You require complex video editing, filtering, or merging capabilities.
You need extensive format transcoding outside of standard platform codecs.
strengths: No large FFmpeg binary or GPL license constraints.
Cross-platform support including Android, iOS, and Web.
Precise target size and quality configuration APIs.
weaknesses: Some specific advanced platform configurations (like audio bitrate or frame-rate decimation on Android) are not supported.
Web EXIF metadata is stripped entirely due to canvas re-encoding limitations.
data.setup_notes: No permissions declared by default; add foreground service or storage permissions only if background compression or specific downloads saving is needed.

alternatives.name: video_player
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need to play videos rather than compress and transcode them.
